title: Tërshena e Kukësit
description: Autumn hike on the Tërshena trail near Kukës, close to the Kosovo border. Through a canyon to the Shkalla e Keqe natural monument, the old towers of Rrasa and a water mill, up to 1850 m with a panoramic view. Departure 07:00 from Prishtinë; pick-ups on the way (Fushë Kosovë, Komoran, Arllat, Suharekë, Prizren). Price includes transport and guide.

title: Maja e Hasanit / Lipa, Rugova
description: Ridge hike to Maja e Hasanit (Lipa, 1900 m) above Peja in the Rugova mountains, known for its rocky formations and views over Peja and the Dukagjin plain. About 8 km round trip, suitable for beginners. Bus departs 06:45 from Ulpianë, Prishtinë (pick-ups in Lakrisht, Fushë Kosovë and Peja); return around 19:00. Led by a certified IML mountain leader. Price includes transport and participation.

title: Gryka e Motinës – Dragobi
description: Autumn hike through the Motina gorge in Dragobi, Tropojë, in the Albanian Alps: a glacial valley with steep slopes, dense pine forests and the Motina river. About 9 km round trip, suitable for beginners. Bus departs 07:00 from Prishtina train station, 08:45 from Gjakova. Bring a biometric ID or passport (the trip crosses into Albania). Price includes transport, guide and group participation. Booking deadline: Saturday 19:00.

title: Maja e Sukës, Gollak
description: Easy hike in the Gollak region near Prapashticë and Nishec, up to Maja e Sukës (1145 m), the highest point of the area, with views over the whole region to the border. Suitable for everyone, including children and first-time hikers. Bus departs 08:00 from the Prishtina train station parking.
